setup: Matched source actor functions and fresh optimizers; original inputs,16 workers,70-step complete episodes,batch56,two epochs,unscaled economic returns. Learned state baseline versus zero value head with value loss disabled. Both retain PPO clipping and minibatch advantage normalization.
